content:
It helps to get the holes lined up before putting the rivets in. The stamping likes to spring "open", It's easy to push up on the center part to line up the holes.

For the bottom edge, get a plastic spudger (case opening tool), put it in the crack below the panel, push up a millimeter or so, and the holes line up and the rivets go in easy. The plastic won't mar the paint like a metal tool will.
Thanks for sending new rivets, the old ones are a bit harder to reuse.
